description.en: A 3D Rubik's Cube: climb 15 levels from a one-move scramble to a full one, solve the daily cube, and watch a layer-by-layer solver teach the beginner's method. Unfolds into a flat net too.
description.zh: 3D 魔方：从打乱一步到完全打乱，闯过 15 关；挑战每日魔方；看分层解法一步步演示新手公式。还能展开成平面图。

title.en: Solve a fully scrambled cube without help
title.zh: 不靠提示还原完全打乱的魔方

title.en: Solve a full scramble in under 5 minutes
title.zh: 5 分钟内还原完全打乱的魔方

title.en: Solve a full scramble in under 2 minutes
title.zh: 2 分钟内还原完全打乱的魔方

title.en: Solve a full scramble in under 1 minute
title.zh: 1 分钟内还原完全打乱的魔方

title.en: Watch the solver solve a scrambled cube
title.zh: 看解法还原一个打乱的魔方
